literature.headline_zh: 人肠道病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期人肠道病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 生长曲线分析表明,与亲代HB19-1病毒相比,rHB19-GFP在早期时间点的复制动力学较慢,但病毒滴度峰值没有显着差异。此外,5-(N-乙基-N-异丙基)阿米洛利 (EIPA) 被发现可以抑制 BEV 复制。 [10.1007/s00705-026-06707-0]
2,168 名儿童中有 14 名 (0.6%) 被检测出 EV-D68,大多数病例发生在 2023 年 1 月。EV-D68 阳性儿童更有可能需要补充氧气(64.3% vs 37.2%,p=0.047),并且入院重症监护的可能性更高(21.4%)。一名同时检测出腺病毒的儿童插管后死亡,凸显了出现严重后果的可能性。 [10.1093/jpids/piag070/piag070.041]
所开发的检测方法显示出高特异性,仅对EV-C99观察到扩增。检测限(LOD)为3.66 × 10^-1拷贝/μL,较常规RT-PCR灵敏度提高100倍。在92份废水样本中,1份(1.09%)样本检测为EV-C99阳性,该结果通过常规RT-PCR及测序予以确认。 [10.21203/rs.3.rs-10274862/v1]
灭活EV-A71 疫苗在接种儿童中展现出强效免疫原性,显著提高血清阳性率和血清转化率;对EV-A71相关手足口病的有效性超过98%;安全性可接受,两组间自发性不良事件均为轻度且相当。 [10.1080/14760584.2026.2722426]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Growth curve analysis showed that rHB19-GFP had slower replication kinetics at early time points compared to the parental HB19-1 virus, but no significant difference in peak viral titers. Additionally, 5-(N-Ethyl-N-isopropyl)amiloride (EIPA) was found to inhibit BEV replication. [10.1007/s00705-026-06707-0]

EV-D68 was detected in 14 out of 2,168 children (0.6%), with most cases occurring in January 2023. EV-D68-positive children were more likely to require supplemental oxygen (64.3% vs 37.2%, p=0.047) and had a higher likelihood of intensive care admission (21.4%). [10.1093/jpids/piag070/piag070.041]

The developed assay demonstrated high specificity, with amplification observed exclusively for EV-C99. The limit of detection (LOD) was 3.66 × 10 − 1 copies/μL, representing a 100-fold increase in sensitivity compared with conventional RT-PCR. [10.21203/rs.3.rs-10274862/v1]

Inactivated EV-A71 vaccines demonstrate robust immunogenicity with significantly increased seropositivity and seroconversion in vaccinated children, high clinical efficacy exceeding 98% against EV-A71-associated HFMD, and an acceptable safety profile with mild and comparable adverse events between vaccinated and placebo groups. [10.1080/14760584.2026.2722426]

news.headline_zh: 人肠道病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期人肠道病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 卫生部目前正在评估 疫苗 候选药物治疗手足口病的可行性,手足口病是由柯萨奇病毒 A16、柯萨奇病毒 A6 和肠道病毒 A71 (EV-A71) 等肠道病毒引起的。 [news-fc36fc8550e58080]
马来西亚卫生部(MOH)正在评估手足口病疫苗(疫苗接种)是否应纳入其防控策略,指出现有疫苗(疫苗)仅针对EV-A71,该病毒在马来西亚今年检测到的肠道病毒中占比仅为1.5%。 [news-688244165e87f498]
中国已有针对手足口病(HFMD)的 疫苗 疫苗,该疫苗靶向 EV-A71 株,但医护专业人员表示,由于其对其他常见手足口病病毒(如柯萨奇病毒 A16)的有效性有限,目前尚未到将其纳入国家免疫规划的时机。 [news-12c1eb50b2b478e0]

news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Human enteroviruses news developments.
key_findings_en: The Health Ministry is currently evaluating the feasibility of a vaccine candidate for HFMD, which is caused by enteroviruses such as Coxsackievirus A16, Coxsackievirus A6, and Enterovirus A71 (EV-A71). [news-fc36fc8550e58080]

The Ministry of Health (MOH) is evaluating whether vaccination should be part of its strategy against HFMD, noting that the available vaccine targets only EV-A71, which accounts for 1.5% of detected enteroviruses in Malaysia this year. [news-688244165e87f498]

A vaccine against hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) is available in China and targets the EV-A71 strain, but healthcare professionals state it is not yet time to include it in the National Immunisation Programme due to its limited effectiveness against other common HFMD viruses like Coxsackievirus A16. papers.title: Enterovirus D68 Detection Among Hospitalized Children with Acute Respiratory Illness in Amman, Jordan
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Enterovirus D68 (EV-D68) primarily causes respiratory illness in children but is also associated with serious neurological outcomes. Although EV-D68 circulation has historically demonstrated a biennial pattern, with peaks during summer and fall, infections can occur year-round, with unpredictable outbreaks. Notable outbreaks occurred in the U.S. in 2014, in Canada in 2022, and more recently in Senegal in late 2023, leading to increased hospitalizations in affected children. However, data are lacking in the Middle East. This study aims to describe EV-D68 circulation and clinical severity among hospitalized children in Amman, Jordan. Methods Data were obtained from a prospective viral surveillance study conducted at Al-Bashir Hospital, the largest public hospital in Amman, from January 2023 to April 2024. The study population included children under 5 years hospitalized with fever or respiratory symptoms. Nasal and throat swabs were collected and tested for EV-D68 and other respiratory viruses using RT-qPCR. Demographic and clinical information were gathered through parental interviews and medical chart reviews. Results Of the 2,168 children enrolled, we identified 14 (0.6%) cases of EV-D68, with 13 occurring in January 2023 and one in February 2023. Table 1 compares EV-D68–positive children to EV-D68–negative children. The median age of EV-D68–positive children was 5.2 months (IQR, 1.3–15.4), and most were female (64.3%). The majority were previously healthy (78.6%) and born at term (85.7%). The most common presenting symptoms were cough (100.0%), congestion or runny nose (78.6%), and shortness of breath (78.6%). Fever, reported in two cases (14.3%), was significantly more common in children negative for EV-D68 (59.7%). Another virus was co-detected with EV-D68 in 6 cases (42.9%). Children with EV-D68 were more likely to receive supplemental oxygen during hospitalization (64.3% vs 37.2%, p=0.047). Intensive care was required for three EV-D68-positive cases (21.4%). Among them, one child with adenovirus co-detection was intubated and subsequently died. Figure 1 provides a detailed visual breakdown of the clinical characteristics, presenting symptoms, co-detections, and in-hospital outcomes of the 14 EV-D68–positive cases. Conclusion Our findings underscore that EV-D68, while infrequent, can lead to significant clinical severity among young children. As global circulation patterns of EV-D68 remain insufficiently understood, ongoing surveillance is critical. With monoclonal antibodies in development, monitoring EV-D68 circulation and identifying children at higher risk could enable timely preventive interventions, potentially mitigating EV-D68-associated morbidity and improving clinical outcomes.

analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The study is a prospective viral surveillance study conducted at Al-Bashir Hospital in Amman, Jordan, from January 2023 to April 2024. elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该研究是一项前瞻性病毒 监测 研究,于 2023 年 1 月至 2024 年 4 月在约旦安曼的 Al-Bashir 医院进行。数据是通过使用 RT-qPCR 测试 EV-D68 和其他呼吸道病毒的鼻咽拭子收集的,同时还通过家长访谈和医疗图表审查收集了人口和临床信息。研究人群包括因发烧或呼吸道症状住院的 5 岁以下儿童。

elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 正在进行的 监测 对于更好地了解 EV-D68 全球流通模式至关重要。监测 EV-D68 并识别高危儿童可以及时采取预防性干预措施,特别是随着单克隆抗体的开发,以减轻相关发病率并改善临床结果。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 肠道病毒D68型(EV-D68)主要引起儿童呼吸系统疾病,同时也与严重神经系统结局相关。尽管EV-D68的流行历史上呈现出每两年一次的模式,在夏季和秋季达到高峰,但感染可全年发生,且具有不可预测的暴发。美国于2014年、加拿大于2022年及最近在2023年末的塞内加尔均出现了显著的暴发,导致受影响儿童住院率增加。然而,中东地区的相关数据仍然缺乏。本研究旨在描述约旦安曼儿童住院病例中EV-D68的流行和临床严重程度。方法 数据来源于2023年1月至2024年4月在约旦最大的公立医院——巴希尔医院开展的一项前瞻性病毒监测研究。研究人群为5岁以下因发热或呼吸道症状住院的儿童。采集鼻咽拭子并使用RT-qPCR检测EV-D68及其他呼吸道病毒。通过家长访谈和医疗记录回顾收集人口统计学和临床信息。结果 在2,168名入组儿童中,共检测出14例(0.6%)EV-D68感染病例,其中13例发生于2023年1月,1例发生于2023年2月。表1比较了EV-D68阳性儿童与EV-D68阴性儿童的临床特征。EV-D68阳性儿童的中位年龄为5.2个月(四分位距,1.3–15.4),大多数为女性(64.3%)。多数既往健康(78.6%)且足月出生(85.7%)。最常见的症状为咳嗽(100.0%)、鼻塞或流涕(78.6%)及呼吸困难(78.6%)。发热在两例患儿(14.3%)中报告,而在EV-D68阴性儿童中显著更常见(59.7%)。另有6例(42.9%)EV-D68感染患儿同时检测出其他病毒。EV-D68感染儿童在住院期间更可能接受辅助吸氧(64.3% vs 37.2%,p=0.047)。3例EV-D68阳性患儿(21.4%)需要重症监护。其中1例合并腺病毒检测的患儿需行气管插管,并最终死亡。图1详细展示了14例EV-D68阳性病例的临床特征、症状、共感染及住院结局。结论 本研究结果强调,EV-D68虽然罕见,但可导致幼儿出现显著临床严重程度。由于EV-D68的全球流行模式仍未充分明确,持续的监测至关重要。随着单克隆抗体的研发,监测EV-D68流行并识别高风险儿童,可能使及时预防干预成为可能,从而潜在地减轻EV-D68相关发病率并改善临床结局。

papers.title: A Sensitive and Specific One-step TaqMan RT-qPCR Assay for Rapid Detection of Enterovirus C99
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Enterovirus C99 (EV-C99) is an emerging member of the Enterovirus C with an expanding geographic distribution and documented cross-species transmission. Current detection methods, including conventional and nested RT-PCR, are limited by prolonged turnaround times and increased risk of cross-contamination which causes false-positive results. This study aimed to develop a rapid, sensitive, and specific assay for EV-C99 detection to further support epidemiological investigations. Methods A one-step TaqMan one-step RT-qPCR assay targeting a conserved region of the VP1 gene of EV-C99 was designed and optimized. Specificity of the method was evaluated against multiple enteroviruses, including Coxsackievirus A8, Coxsackievirus A24, Echovirus 6, Poliovirus, EV-C96, and EV-D68. Sensitivity, linearity, and intra-assay repeatability were determined using 10-fold serial dilutions of a plasmid standard (3.66 × 10 5 to 3.66 × 10 − 1 copies/μL). The assay was subsequently applied to 92 enterovirus-positive wastewater samples collected during 2024–2025, and positive results were validated by Sanger sequencing of VP1. Results The developed assay demonstrated high specificity, with amplification observed exclusively for EV-C99. The limit of detection (LOD) was 3.66 × 10 − 1 copies/μL, representing a 100-fold increase in sensitivity compared with conventional RT-PCR. The standard curve exhibited good linearity across the dynamic range, and intra-assay coefficients of variation (CV) ranged from 0.64% to 2.19%. The total assay completed within approximately 2 hours, significantly shorter than conventional RT-PCR time of about 4–6 hours. Among 92 wastewater samples, one (1.09%) was tested positive for EV-C99, and this result was confirmed by conventional RT-PCR and sequencing. Conclusions In this study, we established a rapid, sensitive, and specific one-step TaqMan RT-qPCR assay for EV-C99 detection. The method provides a reliable tool for laboratory diagnosis and environmental surveillance of EV-C99, facilitating improved monitoring of EV-C99 circulation.

papers.title_zh: 一种用于快速检测肠道病毒 C99 的灵敏且特异的一步 TaqMan RT-qPCR 检测
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Enterovirus C99 (EV-C99) is an emerging member of the Enterovirus C with an expanding geographic distribution and documented cross-species transmission. Current detection methods, including conventional and nested RT-PCR, are limited by prolonged turnaround times and increased risk of cross-contamination which causes false-positive results. This study aimed to develop a rapid, sensitive, and specific assay for EV-C99 detection to further support epidemiological investigations. Methods A one-step TaqMan one-step RT-qPCR assay targeting a conserved region of the VP1 gene of EV-C99 was designed and optimized. Specificity of the method was evaluated against multiple enteroviruses, including Coxsackievirus A8, Coxsackievirus A24, Echovirus 6, Poliovirus, EV-C96, and EV-D68. Sensitivity, linearity, and intra-assay repeatability were determined using 10-fold serial dilutions of a plasmid standard (3.66 × 10 5 to 3.66 × 10 − 1 copies/μL). The assay was subsequently applied to 92 enterovirus-positive wastewater samples collected during 2024–2025, and positive results were validated by Sanger sequencing of VP1. Results The developed assay demonstrated high specificity, with amplification observed exclusively for EV-C99. The limit of detection (LOD) was 3.66 × 10 − 1 copies/μL, representing a 100-fold increase in sensitivity compared with conventional RT-PCR. The standard curve exhibited good linearity across the dynamic range, and intra-assay coefficients of variation (CV) ranged from 0.64% to 2.19%. The total assay completed within approximately 2 hours, significantly shorter than conventional RT-PCR time of about 4–6 hours. Among 92 wastewater samples, one (1.09%) was tested positive for EV-C99, and this result was confirmed by conventional RT-PCR and sequencing. Conclusions In this study, we established a rapid, sensitive, and specific one-step TaqMan RT-qPCR assay for EV-C99 detection. The method provides a reliable tool for laboratory diagnosis and environmental surveillance of EV-C99, facilitating improved monitoring of EV-C99 circulation.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 肠道病毒 C99 (EV-C99) 是肠道病毒 C 的一个新兴成员,其地理分布范围不断扩大,并有记录的跨物种 传播。目前的检测方法,包括传统和巢式 RT-PCR,都受到周转时间延长和交叉污染风险增加的限制,从而导致假阳性结果。本研究旨在开发一种快速、灵敏且特异的 EV-C99 检测方法,以进一步支持流行病学调查。方法 设计并优化了针对 EV-C99 VP1 基因保守区域的一步 TaqMan 一步 RT-qPCR 检测方法。针对多种肠道病毒(包括柯萨奇病毒 A8、柯萨奇病毒 A24、埃可病毒 6、脊髓灰质炎病毒、EV-C96 和 EV-D68)评估了该方法的特异性。使用质粒标准品的 10 倍连续稀释(3.66 × 10 5 至 3.66 × 10 - 1 拷贝/μL)确定灵敏度、线性和测定内重复性。随后将该测定应用于 2024 年至 2025 年期间收集的 92 个肠道病毒阳性废水样本,并通过 VP1 的桑格测序验证了阳性结果。结果 开发的检测方法表现出高特异性,仅观察到 EV-C99 的扩增。检测限 (LOD) 为 3.66 × 10 - 1 拷贝/μL,与传统 RT-PCR 相比,灵敏度提高了 100 倍。标准曲线在整个动态范围内表现出良好的线性,批内变异系数 (CV) 范围为 0.64% 至 2.19%。整个检测在大约 2 小时内完成,明显短于传统 RT-PCR 约 4-6 小时的时间。92个废水样本中,有1个(1.09%)EV-C99检测呈阳性,这一结果通过常规RT-PCR和测序得到证实。结论 在本研究中,我们建立了一种快速、灵敏且特异的一步式 TaqMan RT-qPCR 检测方法,用于检测 EV-C99。该方法为EV-C99的实验室诊断和环境监测提供了可靠的工具,有助于改进EV-C99循环的监测。

papers.full_text: Abstract In recent years, bovine enterovirus (BEV) has been increasingly associated with diarrhea in cattle in China, posing new challenges for disease control in the cattle industry. However, the mechanisms underlying BEV pathogenesis and virulence remain poorly understood. Infectious cDNA clones provide a powerful tool for dissecting viral replication and pathogenic mechanisms. In this study, we generated a full-length infectious cDNA clone of the BEV-F isolate HB19-1. Three overlapping fragments spanning the complete viral genome were amplified by RT-PCR and assembled downstream of a cytomegalovirus (CMV) promoter placed immediately upstream of the 5’ untranslated region (5’UTR). To establish a reporter virus system, the green fluorescent protein (GFP) gene was inserted between the 5’UTR and the N terminus of VP4, followed by a 2A cleavage sequence (IKTAG) at the C terminus of GFP. The recombinant rHB19-GFP virus was successfully rescued. Growth curve analysis demonstrated that rHB19-GFP exhibited slower replication kinetics at early time points relative to the parental HB19-1 virus, with no significant difference in their peak viral titers. This GFP-expressing reporter virus enables convenient monitoring of BEV replication and provides a useful platform for antiviral screening. Using this system, we found that 5-(N-Ethyl-N-isopropyl)amiloride (EIPA) inhibited BEV replication, suggesting its potential as an antiviral candidate. Overall, the rHB19-GFP infectious clone developed here offers a practical tool for studying BEV biology and for identifying antiviral compounds against BEV. Data availability No datasets were generated or analysed during the current study. full_text_sections.full_text: Abstract In recent years, bovine enterovirus (BEV) has been increasingly associated with diarrhea in cattle in China, posing new challenges for disease control in the cattle industry. However, the mechanisms underlying BEV pathogenesis and virulence remain poorly understood. Infectious cDNA clones provide a powerful tool for dissecting viral replication and pathogenic mechanisms. In this study, we generated a full-length infectious cDNA clone of the BEV-F isolate HB19-1. Three overlapping fragments spanning the complete viral genome were amplified by RT-PCR and assembled downstream of a cytomegalovirus (CMV) promoter placed immediately upstream of the 5’ untranslated region (5’UTR). To establish a reporter virus system, the green fluorescent protein (GFP) gene was inserted between the 5’UTR and the N terminus of VP4, followed by a 2A cleavage sequence (IKTAG) at the C terminus of GFP. The recombinant rHB19-GFP virus was successfully rescued. Growth curve analysis demonstrated that rHB19-GFP exhibited slower replication kinetics at early time points relative to the parental HB19-1 virus, with no significant difference in their peak viral titers. This GFP-expressing reporter virus enables convenient monitoring of BEV replication and provides a useful platform for antiviral screening. Using this system, we found that 5-(N-Ethyl-N-isopropyl)amiloride (EIPA) inhibited BEV replication, suggesting its potential as an antiviral candidate. Overall, the rHB19-GFP infectious clone developed here offers a practical tool for studying BEV biology and for identifying antiviral compounds against BEV. Data availability No datasets were generated or analysed during the current study. analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to develop a rapid antiviral screening assay for bovine enterovirus (BEV) to address the lack of understanding about its pathogenesis and virulence mechanisms, which are critical for disease control in the cattle industry.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved generating a full-length infectious cDNA clone of the BEV-F isolate HB19-1 and establishing a reporter virus system using green fluorescent protein (GFP). The research was conducted in a laboratory setting and focused on the BEV isolate HB19-1.
analysis.methods: Three overlapping fragments of the BEV genome were amplified by RT-PCR and assembled downstream of a cytomegalovirus (CMV) promoter. The GFP gene was inserted between the 5’UTR and the N terminus of VP4, followed by a 2A cleavage sequence to create the recombinant rHB19-GFP virus.
analysis.main_results: Growth curve analysis showed that rHB19-GFP had slower replication kinetics at early time points compared to the parental HB19-1 virus, but no significant difference in peak viral titers. Additionally, 5-(N-Ethyl-N-isopropyl)amiloride (EIPA) was found to inhibit BEV replication.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the results as demonstrating the utility of the rHB19-GFP reporter virus for monitoring BEV replication and as a platform for antiviral screening, highlighting the potential of EIPA as an antiviral candidate.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide a practical tool for studying BEV biology and for identifying antiviral compounds, which can inform future research and development of targeted therapies for BEV-related diseases in cattle.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by the absence of datasets and the focus on a single BEV isolate, which may restrict generalizability. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the controlled laboratory environment and limited scope.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to develop a rapid antiviral screening assay for bovine enterovirus (BEV) to better understand its replication and pathogenic mechanisms. The researchers generated an infectious cDNA clone of the BEV-F isolate HB19-1 and inserted a green fluorescent protein (GFP) gene to create a reporter virus system. The results showed that the recombinant rHB19-GFP virus had slower replication kinetics at early time points compared to the parental HB19-1 virus, but similar peak titers. Additionally, EIPA was found to inhibit BEV replication, suggesting its potential as an antiviral candidate. The study provides a useful platform for BEV research and antiviral screening, though its findings are limited to a single isolate and lack broader datasets. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the controlled laboratory setting and the absence of clinical data.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在开发一种快速抗病毒药物筛查试剂盒,用于牛肠道病毒(BEV),以解决对其发病机制及毒力机制的认知缺口,这些机制对奶牛业疾病控制至关重要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 研究通过构建牛肠道病毒(BEV)-F分离株HB19-1的全长感染性cDNA克隆,并利用绿色荧光蛋白(GFP)建立报告病毒系统。研究在实验室环境中进行,并以BEV分离株HB19-1为重点对象。
elements_zh.methods: 通过RT-PCR扩增BEV 基因组的三个重叠片段,并在巨细胞病毒(CMV)启动子下游进行组装。GFP基因被插入在5’UTR与VP4 N端之间,并在其后连接2A切割序列,以构建重组rHB19-GFP病毒。
elements_zh.main_results: 生长曲线分析表明,与亲代HB19-1病毒相比,rHB19-GFP在早期时间点的复制动力学较慢,但病毒滴度峰值没有显着差异。此外,5-(N-乙基-N-异丙基)阿米洛利 (EIPA) 被发现可以抑制 BEV 复制。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将结果解释为证明了 rHB19-GFP 报告病毒在监测 BEV 复制方面的实用性以及作为 抗病毒药物 筛选平台的效用,强调了 EIPA 作为 抗病毒药物 候选者的潜力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为研究 BEV 生物学和鉴定 抗病毒药物 化合物提供了实用工具,可以为未来牛 BEV 相关疾病的靶向治疗的研究和开发提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受限于数据集的缺失以及仅针对单一BEV分离株的重点,可能限制结果的普遍性。由于在受控实验室环境中进行且研究范围有限,证据强度为中等。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 研究通过构建牛肠道病毒(BEV)-F分离株HB19-1的全长感染性cDNA克隆,并利用绿色荧光蛋白(GFP)建立报告病毒系统。研究在实验室环境中进行,并以BEV分离株HB19-1为重点对象。
analysis_zh.methods: 通过RT-PCR扩增BEV 基因组的三个重叠片段,并在巨细胞病毒(CMV)启动子下游进行组装。GFP基因被插入在5’UTR与VP4 N端之间,并在其后连接2A切割序列,以构建重组rHB19-GFP病毒。
analysis_zh.main_results: 生长曲线分析表明,与亲代HB19-1病毒相比,rHB19-GFP在早期时间点的复制动力学较慢,但病毒滴度峰值没有显着差异。此外,5-(N-乙基-N-异丙基)阿米洛利 (EIPA) 被发现可以抑制 BEV 复制。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将结果解释为证明了 rHB19-GFP 报告病毒在监测 BEV 复制方面的实用性以及作为 抗病毒药物 筛选平台的效用,强调了 EIPA 作为 抗病毒药物 候选者的潜力。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为研究 BEV 生物学和鉴定 抗病毒药物 化合物提供了实用工具,可以为未来牛 BEV 相关疾病的靶向治疗的研究和开发提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受限于数据集的缺失以及仅针对单一BEV分离株的重点,可能限制结果的普遍性。由于在受控实验室环境中进行且研究范围有限,证据强度为中等。

papers.title: Comparison of immunogenicity, safety, and efficacy of EVA71 vaccine in children: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Enterovirus 71 (EV-A71) is a principal cause of hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD), potentially leading to severe neurological complications in children. Inactivated EV-A71 vaccines have been introduced. This study compares the immunogenicity, safety, and efficacy of EV-A71 vaccines versus placebo in pediatric populations. RESEARCH DESIGN AND METHODS: Following a PROSPERO-registered protocol, RCTs involving EV-A71 in children were identified via PubMed, Scopus, Cochrane, and ClinicalTrials.gov. Two independent reviewers performed screening, extraction, and RoB assessments (RoB 2.0). RESULTS: Five phase III RCTs involving 36,659 children were included. EV-A71 vaccination significantly increased seropositivity across follow-up periods, including early (RR 5.8), medium-term (RR 3.09), and long-term (RR 2.95) response. Seroconversion was significantly higher in the vaccinated group (pooled RR 13.04, 95% CI 2.80-60.61; p < 0.001). Geometric mean titers, analyzed using the ratio of means approach, were significantly higher in the vaccinated group during early and medium-term follow-up. Vaccine efficacy against EV-A71-associated HFMD exceeded 98% (pooled RR 0.02, 95% CI 0.01-0.09; p = 0.0028; I2 = 50%). Solicited local and systemic adverse events were mild and comparable between groups. CONCLUSION: Inactivated EV-A71 vaccines robust immunogenicity, high clinical efficacy, and an acceptable safety profile in children. Future studies should explore long-term protection, booster schedules, and multivalent formulations against non-EV-A71 serotypes.

papers.source_body_en: INTRODUCTION: Enterovirus 71 (EV-A71) is a principal cause of hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD), potentially leading to severe neurological complications in children. Inactivated EV-A71 vaccines have been introduced. This study compares the immunogenicity, safety, and efficacy of EV-A71 vaccines versus placebo in pediatric populations. RESEARCH DESIGN AND METHODS: Following a PROSPERO-registered protocol, RCTs involving EV-A71 in children were identified via PubMed, Scopus, Cochrane, and ClinicalTrials.gov. Two independent reviewers performed screening, extraction, and RoB assessments (RoB 2.0). RESULTS: Five phase III RCTs involving 36,659 children were included. EV-A71 vaccination significantly increased seropositivity across follow-up periods, including early (RR 5.8), medium-term (RR 3.09), and long-term (RR 2.95) response. Seroconversion was significantly higher in the vaccinated group (pooled RR 13.04, 95% CI 2.80-60.61; p < 0.001). Geometric mean titers, analyzed using the ratio of means approach, were significantly higher in the vaccinated group during early and medium-term follow-up. Vaccine efficacy against EV-A71-associated HFMD exceeded 98% (pooled RR 0.02, 95% CI 0.01-0.09; p = 0.0028; I2 = 50%). Solicited local and systemic adverse events were mild and comparable between groups. CONCLUSION: Inactivated EV-A71 vaccines robust immunogenicity, high clinical efficacy, and an acceptable safety profile in children. Future studies should explore long-term protection, booster schedules, and multivalent formulations against non-EV-A71 serotypes.

Login In Now Don't show this again TOPICS: HazeState Polls 2026Middle East ConflictHeatwaveNegri CrisisConnecting CommunitiesTrue or NotSabah & SarawakSOBA 2026Do You Know Nation ‘Vax for HFMD being assessed’ By KHOO GEK SAN and RAGANANTHINI VETHASALAM Wednesday, 26 Aug 2026 share bookmark Related Stories Nation 26 Aug 2026 ‘HFMD vaccine works, but policy calls for patience’ Nation 03 Sep 2020 Malaysian honoured for work on vaccine Nation 01 Jun 2022 Health Ministry: HFMD cases rise 28 times compared to last year Malaysia reported tens of thousands of cases each year, says ministry PETALING JAYA: The Health Ministry is currently evaluating the feasibility of a vaccine candidate for the hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD). The role of the vaccine is being considered in respect of the epidemiology of the disease and the multiple enteroviruses that cause it, said the ministry’s Disease Control Division. Malaysia has been reporting tens of thousands of cases each year. ALSO READ: Weighing the shot to stop the sore effectively The ministry said that HFMD viruses can spread through direct contact with respiratory secretions or saliva, blister fluid and faeces, as well as contaminated surfaces or objects. HFMD, which usually affects young children, is caused by 20 types of enteroviruses, particularly Coxsackievirus A16, Coxsackievirus A6 and Enterovirus A71 (EV-A71). StarPicks TNB deliver resilient 1H 2026 performance, protecting the rakyat amid West Asia volatility ALSO READ: ‘HFMD vaccine works, but policy calls for patience’ “The currently available vaccine provides protection specifically against EV-A71,” the division told The Star. However, it pointed out that EV-A71 accounted for only 1.5% of enteroviruses detected so far this year. CLICK TO ENLARGE It explained that the majority of the cases involved other enteroviruses such as Pan-Enterovirus and Coxsackievirus A6. As such, it said the role of the EV-A71 vaccine needs to be considered in the context of the viruses that are currently circulating in Malaysia. “The ministry will continue to monitor the HFMD situation, enteroviruses and emerging scientific evidence. We will review the need and appropriate role of HFMD vaccination in Malaysia from time to time,” it said. A local pharmaceutical company is looking to import and market the finished vaccine before moving toward local production. According to the company, the vaccine from China is being reviewed by the National Pharmaceutical Regulatory Agency. It is intended for children aged between six months and six years. Three versions of the HFMD vaccines against EV71 have been approved for use in China. According to the World Health Organisation, the efficacy of these three vaccines after two doses saw immunisation ranging from 90% to 97.4% after one year of surveillance. In Malaysia, HFMD cases went up by 266% in the first quarter of last year compared with the same period in 2024. “The increase in cases last year was likely due to a combination of the natural cyclical pattern of HFMD, changes in circulating enteroviruses, and increased transmission through close contact in childcare settings and the community,” said the ministry’s Disease Control Division. “Changes in the main viruses were also noticed, with more cases of Coxsackievirus A16 in 2025, followed by a move towards EV-A71,” it added. This year, the number of cases has declined by almost 83%. As of Aug 22, a total of 40,879 cases have been reported, compared to the 239,907 cases during the same period last year. news.content: Sections Malaysia Business World Opinion Sports & Fitness Culture & Lifestyle Podcast Education Videos Gallery About The Team Contact Us Advertising Privacy Policy Terms of Use About Us Get the app Follow us on Health MOH weighs HFMD vaccine strategy as cases plunge 83% The Ministry says its usefulness must be weighed against the multiple enteroviruses circulating in Malaysia as cases fall sharply this year Updated 3 days ago · Published on 26 Aug 2026 10:51AM Shares The Health Ministry is assessing the potential role of an existing hand, foot and mouth disease vaccine - August 26, 2026 THE Ministry of Health (MOH) is weighing whether vaccination should form part of its strategy against hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD), with the Health Ministry cautioning that the available vaccine targets only one of the many viruses responsible for the disease. The ministry’s Disease Control Division said it was evaluating the feasibility and potential role of HFMD vaccination in the country, considering the epidemiology of the disease and the enteroviruses currently in circulation. “The currently available vaccine provides protection specifically against EV-A71,” the division said. However, EV-A71 accounted for only 1.5% of enteroviruses detected in Malaysia so far this year, while most infections involved other viruses, including Pan-Enterovirus and Coxsackievirus A6. The ministry said this meant the potential role of an EV-A71 vaccine had to be assessed against the broader pattern of HFMD transmission and the viruses driving infections in Malaysia. “The ministry will continue to monitor the HFMD situation, enteroviruses and emerging scientific evidence. We will review the need and appropriate role of HFMD vaccination in Malaysia from time to time,” it said. HFMD, which mainly affects young children, can spread through direct contact with respiratory secretions or saliva, fluid from blisters and faeces, as well as contaminated surfaces and objects. The disease is caused by about 20 types of enteroviruses, with Coxsackievirus A16, Coxsackievirus A6 and EV-A71 among the main strains associated with infections. Malaysia records tens of thousands of HFMD cases annually, with infections surging 266% in the first quarter of last year compared with the corresponding period in 2024. “The increase in cases last year was likely due to a combination of the natural cyclical pattern of HFMD, changes in circulating enteroviruses, and increased transmission through close contact in childcare settings and the community,” said the ministry’s Disease Control Division. “Changes in the main viruses were also noticed, with more cases of Coxsackievirus A16 in 2025, followed by a move towards EV-A71,” The Star cited it saying. The trend has since reversed dramatically, with HFMD cases falling by almost 83% this year. As of Aug 22, Malaysia had recorded 40,879 cases, compared with 239,907 cases during the corresponding period last year. Meanwhile, a local pharmaceutical company is seeking to import and market a finished HFMD vaccine from China, with plans to potentially move towards local production. The vaccine, intended for children aged between six months and six years, is currently under review by the National Pharmaceutical Regulatory Agency. China has approved three EV71 vaccines, while the World Health Organisation has reported efficacy rates ranging from 90% to 97.4% after two doses over one year of surveillance. The ministry’s review therefore comes as Malaysia faces a key policy question: whether an EV-A71 vaccine would provide sufficient public health value when the vast majority of enteroviruses currently detected in the country are not EV-A71, particularly amid a steep decline in overall HFMD infections. - August 26, 2026 Popular Trending Spotlight Malaysia Desa ParkCity deaths: Netizens voice concern, call for increased enforcement, crackdowns on scammers Malaysia Seven Yemenis arrested over dangerous stunt on KL road Malaysia UMNO gives state leaders mandate to negotiate electoral pacts Malaysia Sultan Selangor warns against greed, abuse of trust By Alfian Z.M. PETALING JAYA: A vaccine against hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD), which usually affects children, would offer protection against severe effects, but it is not time yet to include it in the National Immunisation Programme, say healthcare professionals. “The vaccine’s effectiveness is limited to the EV71 strain. It does not protect against other common HFMD viruses like Coxsackievirus A16.” “This limitation means it does not prevent all HFMD cases, which could be a factor in deciding its cost-effectiveness as a public health programme,” said retired health director Datuk Dr Zainal Ariffin Omar. He was asked to comment about the Health Ministry’s move to evaluate the feasibility of a vaccine for the illness. The vaccine, which is available in China, provides protection specifically against EV-A71 (Enterovirus A71), which is one of the many enteroviruses that can cause HFMD. So far, Malaysia has recorded 40,879 HFMD cases this year. The ministry has found that EV-A71 accounted for just 1.5% of the enteroviruses detected so far, though it has found a “shift” towards EV-A71. Dr Zainal, when contacted, said the HFMD vaccine specifically targets the EV71 strain. StarPicks TNB deliver resilient 1H 2026 performance, protecting the rakyat amid West Asia volatility This vaccine has the potential to reduce severe infections and mortality, he said, adding that it is a critical tool for managing these recurring epidemics. However, he said it was not yet time to include the vaccine in the National Immunisation Programme, which outlines mandatory shots for infants and children against diseases such as tuberculosis, diphtheria, tetanus, polio, measles and mumps. Public healthcare specialist Prof Dr Sharifa Ezat Wan Puteh of Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia said an inactivated vaccine is useful to prevent disability or death caused by the illness. It can also help reduce the severity of HFMD caused by other viruses, such as coxsackie or echovirus, she said. “So far, the vaccine acts against HFMD caused by EV-A71. This vaccine would be beneficial for countries with high endemicity. “But we need to be careful if any other side effects occur due to the vaccine.” She said HFMD is endemic and is a childhood illness. PETALING JAYA: A vaccine against hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD), which usually affects children, would offer protection against severe effects, but it is not time yet to include it in the National Immunisation Programme, say healthcare professionals. “The vaccine’s effectiveness is limited to the EV71 strain. It does not protect against other common HFMD viruses like Coxsackievirus A16.” “This limitation means it does not prevent all HFMD cases, which could be a factor in deciding its cost-effectiveness as a public health programme,” said retired health director Datuk Dr Zainal Ariffin Omar. He was asked to comment about the Health Ministry’s move to evaluate the feasibility of a vaccine for the illness. The vaccine, which is available in China, provides protection specifically against EV-A71 (Enterovirus A71), which is one of the many enteroviruses that can cause HFMD. So far, Malaysia has recorded 40,879 HFMD cases this year. The ministry has found that EV-A71 accounted for just 1.5% of the enteroviruses detected so far, though it has found a “shift” towards EV-A71. Dr Zainal, when contacted, said the HFMD vaccine specifically targets the EV71 strain. However, he said it was not yet time to include the vaccine in the National Immunisation Programme, which outlines mandatory shots for infants and children against diseases such as tuberculosis, diphtheria, tetanus, polio, measles and mumps. Public healthcare specialist Prof Dr Sharifa Ezat Wan Puteh of Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia said an inactivated vaccine is useful to prevent disability or death caused by the illness. It can also help reduce the severity of HFMD caused by other viruses, such as coxsackie or echovirus, she said. “So far, the vaccine acts against HFMD caused by EV-A71. This vaccine would be beneficial for countries with high endemicity. “But we need to be careful if any other side effects occur due to the vaccine.” She said HFMD is endemic and is a childhood illness. The incubation period of the virus is said to be three to six days, and in some cases it could be longer, she added. “Some children develop complications such as paralysis (acute flaccid paralysis or AFP), dehydration, meningitis, hepatitis, pancreatitis, encephalitis, and valve and lung inflammation. This may cause deaths, but this is very rare.” Follow us on our official WhatsApp channel for breaking news alerts and key updates! news.summary_zh: 《星报》报道称,针对手足口病(HFMD)的疫苗在中国已可接种,该疫苗主要针对可引发手足口病的多种肠道病毒之一——EV-A71株。然而,医疗专业人士表示,由于该疫苗对其他常见手足口病病毒(如柯萨奇病毒A16)的效果有限,目前尚无必要将其纳入马来西亚国家免疫计划。马来西亚卫生部发现,EV-A71株迄今仅占检测到的肠道病毒的1.5%,尽管该毒株的比例有所上升。今年马来西亚已记录40,879例手足口病病例,疫苗有望减少重症感染并死亡率。尽管疫苗具有一定效益,但其无法预防所有手足口病病例,且存在潜在副作用风险。卫生部正在研究将疫苗纳入国家免疫计划的可行性,该计划涵盖婴幼儿针对结核病、白喉、破伤风、脊髓灰质炎、麻疹及腮腺炎等疾病的强制接种项目。疫苗被视为应对反复暴发的手足口病疫情的关键工具,但其纳入计划仍在审议中。
